subtasks.title: Pure model of one day's achievements, with tests
subtasks.prompt:
Android app in Kotlin (package root `in.tuwi.yogaphone`, sources in app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/, tests in app/src/test/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/, JUnit 4 with org.junit.Assert). Note: `in` is a Kotlin keyword, so the package line is written package `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.insights with backticks around in.

Read first: app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/data/db/FocusEntities.kt (TimeboxSessionEntity, FocusSessionEntity, TimeboxStatus, FocusStatus) and app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/data/db/UsageEntities.kt (UsageAggregateEntity: date String yyyy-MM-dd, packageName, foregroundMinutes Long, eligible Boolean). Also look at app/src/test/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/InsightEngineTest.kt for the test style.

Create app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/DayAchievements.kt containing exactly this pure Kotlin (no Android imports):

```kotlin
data class GoalDone(val title: String, val plannedMinutes: Int, val actualMinutes: Int, val kind: Kind) {
    enum class Kind { TIMEBOX, FOCUS }
}

data class DayAchievements(
    val date: java.time.LocalDate,
    /** Minutes on apps counted against the allowance (UsageAggregateEntity.eligible). Null when there is no usage data for the day. */
    val distractingMinutes: Int?,
    /** The overall daily allowance in minutes, or null when none is set. */
    val allowanceMinutes: Int?,
    /** The same figure for the day before, or null when unknown. */
    val previousDistractingMinutes: Int?,
    val goals: List<GoalDone>,
    /** How many times the user chose to go back at a pause screen. */
    val wentBack: Int,
) {
    val underAllowance: Boolean? get() = ...  // null if either distractingMinutes or allowanceMinutes is null, else distractingMinutes <= allowanceMinutes
    val lessThanDayBefore: Int? get() = ...   // previous - current when both known and previous > current, else null
    val hasContent: Boolean get() = ...       // true when distractingMinutes != null || goals.isNotEmpty() || wentBack > 0
    fun headline(): String = ...
    fun lines(): List<String> = ...
}

object DayAchievementsBuilder {
    fun build(
        date: java.time.LocalDate,
        zone: java.time.ZoneId,
        aggregates: List<UsageAggregateEntity>,
        allowanceMinutes: Int?,
        timeboxes: List<TimeboxSessionEntity>,
        focus: List<FocusSessionEntity>,
        wentBack: Int,
    ): DayAchievements
}
```

Builder rules:
- distractingMinutes: sum of foregroundMinutes of aggregates whose date == date.toString() and eligible == true, as Int; null if there is no aggregate row at all for that date.
- previousDistractingMinutes: the same for date.minusDays(1).
- A timebox counts when status == TimeboxStatus.COMPLETED and its startedAt falls within [date start, next day start) in `zone`. Title = purpose trimmed, or "Timebox" when null or blank. plannedMinutes = plannedMinutes + extendedMinutes. actualMinutes = ((endedAt ?: endAt) - startedAt) / 60_000, at least 0.
- A focus session counts when status == FocusStatus.COMPLETED and startAt is within the day. Title "Focus". plannedMinutes = ((plannedEndAt ?: endedAt ?: startAt) - startAt) / 60_000. actualMinutes = ((endedAt ?: plannedEndAt ?: startAt) - startAt) / 60_000. Both at least 0.
- goals sorted by start time (timeboxes and focus mixed).

Copy rules (minutes are formatted by a private fun minutes(m: Int): String = "45 min" below 60, "2 h" for whole hours, "1 h 20 min" otherwise):
- headline(): join with " · " at most two parts, in this order of preference:
  1. if underAllowance == true: "Under your limit"; else if distractingMinutes != null: "${minutes(distractingMinutes)} on distracting apps".
  2. if goals.size == 1: "1 goal done"; if goals.size > 1: "${goals.size} goals done"; else if lessThanDayBefore != null: "${minutes(lessThanDayBefore)} less than the day before"; else if wentBack > 0: "went back ${wentBack}×" .
  Prefix the result with "Yesterday: ". If no part applies, return "Yesterday".
- lines(): a list for a detail sheet, each a short sentence, in this order, skipping the ones that don't apply:
  "${minutes(d)} on distracting apps, within your ${minutes(a)} limit" (under) or "${minutes(d)} on distracting apps, ${minutes(d - a)} past your limit" (over) or "${minutes(d)} on distracting apps" (no allowance);
  "${minutes(x)} less than the day before" when lessThanDayBefore != null;
  one line per goal: "${title}: ${minutes(actualMinutes)}" plus " of ${minutes(plannedMinutes)}" when actualMinutes != plannedMinutes;
  "You went back instead of opening an app ${wentBack} time(s)" with "1 time" / "N times".

Create app/src/test/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/DayAchievementsTest.kt with at least 8 tests covering: no data (hasContent false, headline "Yesterday"), under and over allowance, no allowance, rows from other dates ignored, non-eligible rows ignored, timebox outside the day ignored, cancelled timebox ignored, blank purpose -> "Timebox", minutes formatting (45 min, 2 h, 1 h 20 min), lessThanDayBefore, headline order. Use ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata") and LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 16).

Do not edit any other file. Do not commit.

subtasks.title: When the morning note shows, with tests
subtasks.prompt:
Android app in Kotlin (sources in app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/, tests in app/src/test/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/, JUnit 4 with org.junit.Assert). `in` is a Kotlin keyword, so the package line is: package `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.insights (with backticks around in).

Create app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/MorningNotePolicy.kt with exactly this pure Kotlin (no Android imports):

```kotlin
object MorningNotePolicy {
    /** The note can appear from this hour (local time) on the first home view of the day. */
    const val START_HOUR = 4
    /** After this hour the note is no longer news and stays hidden. */
    const val END_HOUR = 14

    /**
     * True when the home screen should show the note about yesterday.
     * [closedOn] is the local date on which the user opened or dismissed the note (null if never).
     */
    fun shouldShow(now: java.time.LocalDateTime, closedOn: java.time.LocalDate?, hasContent: Boolean): Boolean
}
```

Rules: false when hasContent is false; false when now.hour < START_HOUR or now.hour >= END_HOUR; false when closedOn == now.toLocalDate(); true otherwise.

Create app/src/test/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/MorningNotePolicyTest.kt with tests: 03:59 hidden, 04:00 shown, 13:59 shown, 14:00 hidden, closed today hidden, closed yesterday shown, no content hidden.

Do not edit any other file. Do not commit.

subtasks.title: Morning note on home: store, loader, home line and sheet
subtasks.prompt:
Android app in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Package root `in`.tuwi.yogaphone (backticks, `in` is a keyword). Sources in app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/.

Read first:
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/DayAchievements.kt (DayAchievements, DayAchievementsBuilder.build(...), headline(), lines(), hasContent)
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/insights/MorningNotePolicy.kt (shouldShow(now, closedOn, hasContent))
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/ui/UpdatePrompt.kt: copy the look of the private HomePromptLine (6 dp accent dot, bodyMedium onSurfaceVariant text, YogaTextButton actions) and of WhatsNewSheet (YogaSheet, YogaEyebrow, headlineLarge title, dot-led lines, Done button).
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/YogaApplication.kt: `database` (YogaDatabase with usageDao() and focusDao()).
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/data/db/UsageEntities.kt: UsageDao.aggregates(start, end), UsageDao.rules() (UsageRuleEntity with id "total" for the overall allowance, field dailyAllowanceMinutes, enabled).
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/data/db/FocusEntities.kt: FocusDao.timeboxesSince(since), focusSince(since), countInterventionsSince(type: String?, action: String, packageName: String?, since: Long).
- app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/intro/IntroStore.kt for how a small DataStore is created in this project.

1. Create insights/MorningNoteController.kt:
```kotlin
class MorningNoteController(private val app: `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.YogaApplication) {
    /** Yesterday's achievements when the note should show now, else null. */
    val note: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<DayAchievements?>
    /** Re-evaluate; call when home resumes. */
    suspend fun refresh()
    /** The user opened or dismissed the note today. */
    suspend fun close()
}
```
Store the closed date (yyyy-MM-dd string) in its own Preferences DataStore named "morning_note" with key "closed_on" (declare `private val Context.morningNoteStore by preferencesDataStore("morning_note")` at top level in this file). refresh(): on Dispatchers.IO, zone = ZoneId.systemDefault(), yesterday = LocalDate.now(zone).minusDays(1); aggregates = usageDao().aggregates(yesterday.minusDays(1).toString(), yesterday.toString()); allowance = usageDao().rules().firstOrNull { it.id == "total" && it.enabled }?.dailyAllowanceMinutes; since = yesterday.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli(); until = since of today; timeboxes = focusDao().timeboxesSince(since); focus = focusDao().focusSince(since); wentBack = focusDao().countInterventionsSince("DELAY", "WENT_BACK", null, since) - focusDao().countInterventionsSince("DELAY", "WENT_BACK", null, until); build DayAchievements with DayAchievementsBuilder.build(yesterday, zone, ...); set note to it when MorningNotePolicy.shouldShow(LocalDateTime.now(zone), closedOn, it.hasContent), else null. Wrap the whole refresh in runCatching so a failure only hides the note. close(): write today's date and set note to null.
Add `val morningNote by lazy { `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.insights.MorningNoteController(this) }` to YogaApplication ONLY IF YogaApplication.kt is listed in your files; it is not, so instead create the controller with `remember { MorningNoteController(app) }` inside the composable in step 2.

2. Create ui/MorningNote.kt with `@Composable fun MorningNote(app: `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.YogaApplication)`. It remembers a MorningNoteController, calls refresh() in a LaunchedEffect keyed on the lifecycle ON_RESUME (use LocalLifecycleOwner and repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) or a LifecycleEventObserver), collects `note`, and when non-null shows a home line in the HomePromptLine style: text = note.headline(), action "See" opens a sheet, secondary action "Not now" calls close(). Long-press on the line also calls close(). The sheet uses YogaSheet: eyebrow = the date formatted like "Monday 16 November", title "Yesterday", then note.lines() each with the 5 dp accent dot, and a "Done" YogaTextButton. Opening the sheet calls close() (so it won't show again today) but keeps the sheet visible until Done or dismiss.

3. In app/src/main/java/in/tuwi/yogaphone/MainActivity.kt find the line `UpdatePrompt(activity, yoga.updateController)` inside statusContent and add directly ABOVE it: `` `in`.tuwi.yogaphone.ui.MorningNote(yoga) `` . Change nothing else in MainActivity.kt.

Do not change the existing update line, the usage indicator, or any other file. Do not commit.
